# Function to allow dynamic plot sizes
subchunkify <- function(g, fig_height=9, fig_width=10, fig_cap) {
  g_deparsed <- paste0(deparse(
    function() {g}
  ), collapse = '')

  sub_chunk <- paste0("
  \n`","``{r sub_chunk_", floor(runif(1) * 10000), ", fig.height=",
   fig_height, ", fig.width=", fig_width, ", echo=FALSE, results='asis'}",
  "\n(", 
    g_deparsed
    , ")()",
  "\n`","``
  ")

  cat(knitr::knit(text = knitr::knit_expand(text = sub_chunk), quiet = TRUE))
}

disc_maps <- list.files("../WQ_Cont_Discrete/output/maps/discrete", full.names=T)
cont_maps <- list.files("../WQ_Cont_Discrete/output/maps/continuous", full.names=T)
sav_maps <- list.files("../SAV/output/maps/", full.names=T)
nekton_maps <- list.files("../Nekton/output/maps/", full.names=T)
coral_maps <- list.files("../Coral/output/maps/", full.names=T)

# Get map function
get_maps <- function(parameter, ma_abrev, type = "disc"){
  if(type %in% c("sav","nekton","cw")){
    pattern <- paste0(ma_abrev, "_map.png")
  } else {
    if(type %in% c("disc","cont")){
      param_short <- websiteParams[ParameterName==parameter, unique(ParameterShort)]
    } else {param_short <- parameter}
    pattern <- paste0(param_short, "_", ma_abrev, "_map.png") 
  }
  str_subset(get(paste0(type, "_maps")), pattern)
}

plot_trendlines_atlas <- function(param, ma, ma_abrev){
  cat("  \n")
  
  skt_stats <- skt_stats_disc[ParameterName==param & ManagedAreaName==ma & Website==1, ]
  skt_stats$p <- round(skt_stats$p,5)
  
  if (nrow(skt_stats) == 0) {
    invisible()
  } else {
    # Locate plot
    plot_loc <- get_plot(ma_abrev = ma_abrev, parameter = param, type = "Discrete", pid = "none")
    # Locate map
    map_loc <- get_maps(parameter = param, ma_abrev = ma_abrev, type = "disc")
    
    # Arrange and display plot and statistic table
    cat("  \n")
    
    # fig_caption <- paste0("Seasonal Kendall-Tau Results for ", param, " - Discrete")
    fig_caption <- FigureCaptions[Parameter==param & SamplingFrequency=="Discrete", FigureCaption]
    subchunkify(cat("![", fig_caption, "](", plot_loc,")"))
    
    # Table descriptions
    tableDesc <- TableDescriptions[Type=="Discrete" & ParameterName==param & ManagedAreaName==ma, Description]
    # tableDesc <- paste0("Seasonal Kendall-Tau Trend Analysis Results for ", param)
    
    # cat("![](", plot_loc,")")
    cat("  \n")
    # Kendall tau results table
    ResultTable <- skt_stats[, c("ActivityType", "Trend", "N_Data", "N_Years", "Period of Record", "Median", "tau", "SennIntercept", "SennSlope", "p")] %>%
      rename("Activity Type" = "ActivityType", "Statistical Trend" = "Trend", 
             "Sample Count" = "N_Data", "Years with Data" = "N_Years", 
             "Median Result Value" = "Median", "Tau" = "tau", "Sen Intercept" = "SennIntercept",
             "Sen Slope" = "SennSlope")
    # Prep for latex-format
    names(ResultTable) <- gsub("_", "-", names(ResultTable))
    result_table <- kable(ResultTable, format="pandoc",
                          caption=tableDesc,
                          row.names = FALSE, digits = 4) %>%
      kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = c("scale_down", "HOLD_position"))
    print(result_table)
    cat("  \n")
    cat("![](", map_loc,")")
    cat("  \n")
  }
}

plot_cont_combined_atlas <- function(param, parameter, region, ma, ma_abrev){
  Mon_YM_Stats <- as.data.table(load_cont_data_table(param, region, "Mon_YM_Stats"))
  Mon_YM_Stats <- Mon_YM_Stats[ManagedAreaName == ma & ParameterName == parameter, ]
  skt_stats <- as.data.table(load_cont_data_table(param, region, "skt_stats"))
  skt_stats <- skt_stats[ManagedAreaName==ma, ]
  skt_stats$p <- round(as.numeric(skt_stats$p), 5)
  
  if(length(unique(skt_stats$ProgramLocationID))>1){
    # Account for managed areas with large number of continuous sites
    # Too many to plot together, plot combined by Program
    if(length(unique(skt_stats$ProgramLocationID))>10){
      for(prog_n in 1:length(unique(skt_stats$ProgramID))){
        # pid is ProgramID, prog_n is the current program's number
        pid <- unique(skt_stats$ProgramID)[prog_n]
        #Locate plot file, including prog_n
        plot_loc <- get_plot(ma_abrev = ma_abrev, parameter = parameter, type = "Continuous", pid = prog_n)
        # Locate map
        map_loc <- get_maps(parameter = parameter, ma_abrev = ma_abrev, type = "cont")
        
        ResultTable <- skt_stats %>%
          filter(ProgramID==pid) %>%
          mutate("Period of Record" = paste0(EarliestYear, " - ", LatestYear)) %>%
          select(ProgramLocationID, Trend, N_Data, N_Years, "Period of Record", Median, tau,
                 SennIntercept, SennSlope, p) %>%
          rename("Station" = "ProgramLocationID",
                 "Statistical Trend" = "Trend", "Sample Count" = "N_Data", 
                 "Years with Data" = "N_Years", "Median Result Value" = "Median",
                 "Tau" = "tau", "Sen Intercept" = "SennIntercept", 
                 "Sen Slope" = "SennSlope") %>%
          mutate_if(is.numeric, ~round(., 2))
        setDT(ResultTable)
        # Remove text-based "NA" values in p column
        if (nrow(ResultTable[ResultTable$p=="    NA", ]) > 0){
          ResultTable[ResultTable$p=="    NA", ]$p <- NA
        }
        ResultTable[is.na(ResultTable)] <- "-"
        
        cat("  \n")
        
        fig_caption <- FigureCaptions[Parameter==parameter & SamplingFrequency=="Continuous", FigureCaption]
        subchunkify(cat("![", fig_caption, "](", plot_loc,")"))

        # cat("![](", plot_loc,")")
        cat("  \n")
        
        # Table descriptions
        tableDesc <- TableDescriptions[Type=="Continuous" & ParameterName==param & ManagedAreaName==ma, Description]
        # tableDesc <- paste0("Seasonal Kendall-Tau Results for All Stations - ", parameter)
        
        result_table <- kable(ResultTable, format="simple",
                              caption=tableDesc,
                              row.names = FALSE, digits = 5) %>%
          kable_styling(font_size=8)
        
        print(result_table)
        cat("  \n")
        cat("![](", map_loc,")")
        cat("\n \n \n")    
      }
    } else {
      #Locate plot file
      plot_loc <- get_plot(ma_abrev = ma_abrev, parameter = parameter, type = "Continuous", pid = "none")
      # Locate map
      map_loc <- get_maps(parameter = parameter, ma_abrev = ma_abrev, type = "cont")
      
      ResultTable <- skt_stats %>%
        mutate("Period of Record" = paste0(EarliestYear, " - ", LatestYear)) %>%
        select(ProgramLocationID, N_Data, N_Years, "Period of Record", Median, tau,
               SennIntercept, SennSlope, p, Trend) %>%
        rename("Station" = "ProgramLocationID","Statistical Trend" = "Trend", 
               "Sample Count" = "N_Data", "Years with Data" = "N_Years", 
               "Median Result Value" = "Median","Tau" = "tau", 
               "Sen Intercept" = "SennIntercept", "Sen Slope" = "SennSlope") %>%
        mutate_if(is.numeric, ~round(., 2)) %>% as.data.table()
      
      # Remove text-based "NA" values in p column
      if (nrow(ResultTable[ResultTable$p=="    NA", ]) > 0){
        ResultTable[ResultTable$p=="    NA", ]$p <- NA
      }
      ResultTable[is.na(ResultTable)] <- "-"
      
      cat("  \n")
      
      fig_caption <- FigureCaptions[Parameter==parameter & SamplingFrequency=="Continuous", FigureCaption]
      subchunkify(cat("![", fig_caption, "](", plot_loc,")"))
      # cat("![](", plot_loc,")")
      
      cat("  \n")
      
      # Table descriptions
      tableDesc <- TableDescriptions[Type=="Continuous" & ParameterName==param & ManagedAreaName==ma, Description]
      # tableDesc <- paste0("Seasonal Kendall-Tau Results for All Stations - ", parameter)
      
      result_table <- kable(ResultTable, format="simple",
                            caption=tableDesc,
                            row.names = FALSE, digits = 5) %>%
        kable_styling(font_size=8)
      
      print(result_table)
      cat("  \n")
      cat("![](", map_loc,")")
      cat("\n \n \n")    
    }
  }
}

plot_sav_trendplot_atlas <- function(ma, ma_abrev, plot_type, plot_list, malist){
  if(ma_abrev %in% malist){
    # Plot
    plot_loc <- str_subset(plot_list, paste0("_", ma_abrev, "_"))
    # Locate map
    map_loc <- get_maps(parameter = "none", ma_abrev = ma_abrev, type = "sav")
    
    fig_caption <- FigureCaptions[Habitat=="Submerged Aquatic Vegetation" & Indicator=="Percent Cover", FigureCaption]
    
    cat("  \n")
    subchunkify(cat("![", fig_caption, "](", plot_loc,")"))
    # cat("![](", plot_loc,")")
    cat("  \n")
    
    # Table

    table <- sav_stats_table[ManagedAreaName == ma, c("Species","StatisticalTrend","years","LME_Intercept","LME_Slope","p")] %>%
      select(Species,StatisticalTrend,years,LME_Intercept,LME_Slope,p)
    
    # Table descriptions
    tableDesc <- TableDescriptions[Type=="Submerged Aquatic Vegetation" & ManagedAreaName==ma, Description]
    # tableDesc <- paste0("Percent Cover Trend Analysis for ", ma)

    sav_kable <- table %>%
      kable(format="simple",caption=tableDesc, booktabs = T, linesep = "",
            col.names = c("CommonName","Trend Significance (0.05)","Period of Record","LME-Intercept","LME-Slope","p")) %>%
      row_spec(0, italic=TRUE) %>%
      kable_styling(latex_options=c("scale_down","hold_position"))
    
    cat("  \n")
    print(sav_kable)
    cat("  \n")
    cat("![](", map_loc,")")
    cat("  \n")
  }
}

plot_nekton_atlas <- function(ma, ma_abrev, MA_Y_Stats = "MA_Y_Stats_nek", MA_Ov_Stats = "MA_Ov_Stats_nek", nekton_plots){
  # Creates a data table object to be shown underneath plots in report
  ResultTable <- MA_Ov_Stats[ManagedAreaName==ma,]
  
  # Removes location, gear, and parameter information because it is in plot
  # labels
  ResultTable <- ResultTable[,-c("AreaID", "ManagedAreaName",
                                 "ProgramIDs", "Programs", "GearType_Plot",
                                 "ParameterName")]
  # Renames StandardDeviation to StDev to save horizontal space
  ResultTable <- ResultTable %>%
    dplyr::rename("StDev"="StandardDeviation")
  # Converts all non-integer values to 2 decimal places for space
  ResultTable$Min <- round(ResultTable$Min, digits=2)
  ResultTable$Max <- round(ResultTable$Max, digits=2)
  ResultTable$Median <- round(ResultTable$Median, digits=2)
  ResultTable$Mean <- round(ResultTable$Mean, digits=2)
  ResultTable$StDev <- round(ResultTable$StDev, digits=2)
  
  ResultTable <- ResultTable %>% 
    mutate("Gear Type" = paste0(GearType, " (", GearSize_m, ")"),
           "Period of Record" = paste0(EarliestYear, " - ", LatestYear)) %>%
    rename("Sample Count" = N_Data,
           "Number of Years" = N_Years,
           "Median N of Taxa" = Median,
           "Mean N of Taxa" = Mean) %>%
    select("Gear Type", "Sample Count", "Number of Years", "Period of Record", 
           "Median N of Taxa", "Mean N of Taxa")
  
  # Convert results table into kable format
  result_table <- kable(ResultTable, format="simple",
                        caption="Nekton Species Richness",
                        row.names = FALSE, digits = 5,
                        booktabs = T, linesep = "", escape = F, longtable = F) %>%
    row_spec(row = 0, italic = TRUE) %>%
    kable_styling(latex_options = c("scale_down", "HOLD_position"))
  # Locate plot
  plot_loc <- str_subset(nekton_plots, paste0("_", ma_abrev, ".png"))
  # Locate map
  map_loc <- get_maps(parameter = "none", ma_abrev = ma_abrev, type = "nekton")
  
  # Print plots
  cat("  \n")
  fig_caption <- FigureCaptions[Habitat=="Water Column" & Indicator=="Nekton", FigureCaption]
  subchunkify(cat("![", fig_caption, "](", plot_loc,")"))
  # cat("![](", plot_loc,")")
  cat("  \n")
  print(result_table)
  cat("  \n")
  cat("![](", map_loc,")")
  cat("  \n")
}

# Function to create statisticalTrend column
checkTrends <- function(p, LME_Slope, SufficientData){
  if(SufficientData){
    if(is.na(LME_Slope)){
      return("Model did not fit the available data")
    } else {
      increasing <- LME_Slope > 0
      trendPresent <- p <= 0.05
      trendStatus <- "No significant trend"
      if(trendPresent){
        trendStatus <- ifelse(increasing, "Significantly increasing trend", 
                              "Significantly decreasing trend")
      }          
    }
  } else {
    trendStatus <- "Insufficient data to calculate trend"
  }
  return(trendStatus)
}

plot_coral_pc_atlas <- function(ma, ma_abrev, lme_plot = lme_plot_pc, coral_pc_plots){
  # Creates a data table object to be shown underneath plots in report
  ResultTable <- lme_plot[ManagedAreaName==ma,]
  ResultTable <- ResultTable %>% rowwise() %>%
    mutate(`Statistical Trend` = checkTrends(p = LME_p, LME_Slope = LME_Slope, 
                                             SufficientData = SufficientData),
           `Period of Record` = paste0(EarliestYear, " - ", LatestYear)) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% rename(`LME Intercept` = LME_Intercept, `LME Slope` = LME_Slope, 
                         `p` = LME_p) %>% 
    select(`Statistical Trend`, `Period of Record`, 
           `LME Intercept`, `LME Slope`, p) %>% as.data.table()
  
  # Convert for kable/latex format (no "_" allowed)
  names(ResultTable) <- gsub("_", "-", names(ResultTable))
  # Convert results table into kable format
  result_table <- kable(ResultTable, format="simple",
                        caption="Coral Percent Cover",
                        row.names = FALSE, digits = 5,
                        booktabs = T, linesep = "", escape = F, longtable = F) %>%
    kable_styling(latex_options = c("scale_down", "HOLD_position"))
  # Locate plot
  plot_loc <- str_subset(coral_pc_plots, paste0("_", ma_abrev, ".png"))
  # Locate map
  map_loc <- get_maps(parameter = "PC", ma_abrev = ma_abrev, type = "coral")
  
  # Print plots
  cat("  \n")
  fig_caption <- FigureCaptions[Habitat=="Coral/Coral Reef" & Indicator=="Percent Cover", FigureCaption]
  subchunkify(cat("![", fig_caption, "](", plot_loc,")"))
  # cat("![](", plot_loc,")")
  cat("  \n")
  print(result_table)
  cat("  \n")
  cat("![](", map_loc,")")
  cat("  \n")
  # Add extra space at the end to prevent the next figure from being too
  # close. Does not add space after last plot
  # if(i!=n){
  #   cat("\n \n \n \n") 
  # }
}

plot_oyster_atlas <- function(ma, ma_abrev, oyster_includes, oy_figs, p){
  subset <- oyster_includes[ManagedAreaName==ma, ]
  
  # parameter subset
  p_subset <- subset[ParameterName==p, ]
  
  p_name <- ifelse(p=="Shell Height", "Size Class",  p)
  
  fig_caption <- FigureCaptions[Habitat=="Oyster/Oyster Reef" & Indicator==p_name, FigureCaption]
  
  hab_types <- unique(p_subset$HabitatType)
  for(type in hab_types){
    cat("  \n")
    cat(glue("### {type}"))
    cat("  \n")
    plot_loc <- oy_file_loc(ma_abrev, p, type)
    subchunkify(cat("![", fig_caption, "](", plot_loc,")"))
    # cat("![](", plot_loc,")")
    cat("  \n")
    # Oyster tables
    oy_tables <- oyster_stats[ManagedAreaName==ma & ParameterName==p & HabitatType==type,]
    ResultTable <- oy_tables %>% 
      select(ShellType, HabitatType, "Trend Status", ModelEstimate, StandardError, 
             "Credible Interval") %>%
      rename("Shell Type" = "ShellType",
             "Habitat Type" = "HabitatType",
             "Estimate" = "ModelEstimate",
             "Standard Error" = "StandardError")

    result_table <- kable(ResultTable, format = "simple",
                          caption = paste0("Model results for Oyster ", p, " - ", type),
                          row.names = FALSE, digits = 2,
                          booktabs = T, linesep = "", escape = F, longtable = F) %>%
      row_spec(row = 0, italic = TRUE) %>%
      kable_styling(latex_options = c("scale_down", "HOLD_position"))
    cat("  \n")
    print(result_table)
    cat("  \n")
  }
  short_p <- ifelse(p=="Density", "Dens", ifelse(p=="Percent Live", "PrcLive", "SH"))
  map_loc <- get_maps(parameter = short_p, ma_abrev = ma_abrev, type = "oyster")
  cat("![](", map_loc,")")
  cat("  \n")
}

```{r plot_all_habs, results='asis', fig.height=4.5, fig.width=5}
# Get list of available Nekton plots
nekton_plots <- list.files("../Nekton/output/Figures", pattern = ".png", full.names=TRUE)
# Get list of available CW plots
cw_plots <- list.files("../Coastal_Wetlands/output/Figures", pattern = ".png", full.names=TRUE)

# Get list of available Coral plots (spec. richness & PC)
coral_pc_plots <- list.files("../Coral/output/PercentCover/Figures", pattern = ".png", full.names=TRUE)
coral_sr_plots <- list.files("../Coral/output/SpeciesRichness/Figures", pattern = ".png", full.names=TRUE)

MA_Ov_Stats_pc <- fread("../Coral/output/PercentCover/Coral_PC_MA_Overall_Stats.txt")
MA_Ov_Stats_pc <- MA_Ov_Stats_pc[!is.na(MA_Ov_Stats_pc$EarliestYear), ]
lme_plot_pc <- fread("../Coral/output/PercentCover/Coral_PC_LME_Stats.txt")

# Species Richness
MA_Y_Stats_sr <- fread("../Coral/output/SpeciesRichness/Coral_SpeciesRichness_MA_Yr_Stats.txt")
MA_Ov_Stats_sr <- fread("../Coral/output/SpeciesRichness/Coral_SpeciesRichness_MA_Overall_Stats.txt")

for(habitat in unique(websiteParams$HabitatName)){
  if(habitat=="Water Column" & !(in_discrete | in_continuous | in_nekton)) next
  if(habitat=="Coastal Wetlands" & !in_cw) next
  if(habitat=="Oyster/Oyster Reef" & !in_oyster) next
  if(habitat=="Coral/Coral Reef" & !in_coral) next
  if(habitat=="Submerged Aquatic Vegetation" & !in_sav) next
  cat("  \n")
  cat(glue("# {habitat}"))
  cat("  \n")
  for(indicator in websiteParams[HabitatName==habitat, unique(IndicatorName)]){
    if(indicator=="Nekton" & !in_nekton) next
    if(indicator=="Water Quality" & (!in_discrete | !in_continuous)) next
    if(indicator=="Water Clarity" & (!in_discrete | !in_continuous)) next
    if(indicator=="Nutrients" & (!in_discrete | !in_continuous)) next
    cat("  \n")
    cat(glue("## {indicator}"))
    cat("  \n")
    # Filter once for the current indicator
    indicator_subset <- websiteParams[HabitatName==habitat & 
                                        IndicatorName == indicator, ]
    for(p in unique(indicator_subset$ParameterName)){
      filteredSubset <- indicator_subset[ParameterName==p, ]
      parameter <- unique(filteredSubset$ParameterName)
      param_short <- unique(filteredSubset$ParameterShort)
      types <- unique(filteredSubset$SamplingFrequency)
      
      if(in_discrete & "Discrete" %in% types){
        cat("  \n")
        cat(glue("### {parameter} - Discrete"))
        cat("  \n")
        plot_trendlines_atlas(param = parameter, ma = ma, ma_abrev = ma_abrev)
      }
      if(in_continuous & param_short %in% cont_params_short & "Continuous" %in% types){
        cat("  \n")
        cat(glue("### {parameter} - Continuous"))
        cat("  \n")
        # extract region for each MA to determine which cont. file to load
        region <- MA_All[ManagedAreaName == ma, unique(Region)]
        
        plot_cont_combined_atlas(param = param_short, parameter = parameter, 
                                 region = region, ma = ma, ma_abrev = ma_abrev)
      }
      if(in_nekton & indicator=="Nekton"){
        cat("  \n")
        plot_nekton_atlas(ma, ma_abrev, MA_Y_Stats_nek, MA_Ov_Stats_nek, nekton_plots)
        cat("  \n")
      }
      if(in_sav & habitat=="Submerged Aquatic Vegetation"){
        cat("  \n")
        plot_sav_trendplot_atlas(ma = ma, ma_abrev = ma_abrev, plot_type = "multiplots", 
                                 plot_list = multiplots, malist = multiplot_malist)
        cat("  \n")
      }
      if(in_cw & habitat=="Coastal Wetlands"){
        cat("  \n")
        plot_cw_atlas(ma, ma_abrev, MA_Ov_Stats_cw, MA_Y_Stats_cw, cw_plots)
        cat("  \n")
      }
      if(in_coral & habitat=="Coral/Coral Reef"){
        cat("  \n")
        if(ma %in% coral_pc_MA_Include & param_short=="PC"){
          cat("  \n")
          plot_coral_pc_atlas(ma, ma_abrev, lme_plot_pc, coral_pc_plots)
          cat("  \n")
        }
  
        if(ma %in% coral_sr_MA_Include & param_short=="PA"){
          cat("  \n")
          plot_coral_sr_atlas(ma, ma_abrev, MA_Ov_Stats_sr, coral_sr_plots)
          cat("  \n")
        }
      }
      if(in_oyster & habitat=="Oyster/Oyster Reef"){
        cat("  \n")
        plot_oyster_atlas(
          ma = ma,
          ma_abrev = ma_abrev,
          oyster_includes = oyster_includes,
          oy_figs = oy_figs,
          p = p
        )
        cat("  \n")
      }

    }
  }
}

```


```{r plotting WQ_Discrete, warning=FALSE, fig.height=9, fig.width=10, results="asis", eval=FALSE, cache=FALSE}
if(in_discrete){
  ma_df <- managed_area_df %>% dplyr::filter(ManagedAreaName == ma)
  p_inc <- unique(ma_df$Parameter)
  d_inc <- unique(ma_df$Depth)
  a_inc <- unique(ma_df$Activity)
  
  cat("\\newpage")
  cat("  \n\n")
  cat("# Water Quality - Discrete  \n")
  
  for(param in p_inc){
    # load overall discrete data
    data <- as.data.frame(load_data_table(param, table="data"))
    
    # getting full parameter & unit names
    parameter <- unique(data$ParameterName)
    unit <- unique(data$ParameterUnits)
    
    cat("  \n")
    subtitle <- glue("## {parameter}")
    cat(subtitle, "\n\n")
    
    #Because secchi depth is does not have a bottom measurement, this statement skips
    #Secchi depth for bottom
    if (param == "Secchi"){
      depth <- "Surface"
    } else {
      depth <- "All"
    }
    
    # Choosing which analyses to plot, when to combine 
    if (param == "ChlaC" |
        param == "Chla" |
        param == "CDOM" |
        param == "TN" |
        param == "TP") {activity = "Lab"} else if (
          param == "DO" |
          param == "DOS" |
          param == "pH" |
          param == "Secchi" |
          param == "TempW") {activity = "Field"} else if (
            param == "Sal" |
            param == "TSS" |
            param == "Turb") {activity = "All"}
  
    if (activity == "All") {
      activity_label <- "Lab and Field Combined"
    } else if (activity == "Field" | activity == "Lab") {
      activity_label <- activity
    }
  
    if (depth == "All") {
      depth_label <- "All Depths"
    } else if (depth == "Surface") {
      depth_label <- "Surface"
    }
    
    ## Show Discrete plots ##
    # Plot
    plot_trendlines_atlas(param = parameter, ma = ma, ma_abrev = ma_abrev)
    # Map
    # plot_discrete_maps(ma_abrev = ma_abrev, param_short = param, param_label = parameter, map_files = discrete_map_locs)
    # # Program Table
    # disc_program_tables(ma = ma, data = data)
  }
}

```
